correctness.rationale: The permutation-sign, coordinate-even component of a degree-eight polynomial is divisible by the degree-six squared-coordinate Vandermonde, with symmetric linear quotient in the squares. It must therefore be a multiple of |x|²Δ, whose Laplacian is 30Δ. Character averaging over the signed-permutation orbit (seed stabilizer flips only its zero coordinate) now gives the universal signed relation. The addition theorem identifies evaluation rank with the Legendre Gram rank; the probability-surface normalization is 2ℓ+1 and changing antipodal representatives only changes some signs. An independent Rodrigues-coefficient calculation gives the nine claimed exact ranks and nonsingularity of all 520 matrices from degree 9 to 528 modulo 65537, distinct from either packaged prime. Integer scaling by 10^ℓ preserves rational rank. Beyond that range the Laplace integral gives |Pℓ(z)| ≤ sqrt(π/[2ℓ(1−z²)]); the observed maximum absolute off-diagonal contact is 4/5, and 11 times the resulting bound is strictly below 1 at ℓ=529. Finally nonzero rational determinants or a rank-11 minor at t=2 yield only finitely many algebraic exceptions per degree, with the universal degree-eight relation providing the upper bound. The minimum-norm interpolant follows from the Gram pseudoinverse with the same kernel normalization.
residual_risks: The finite computation does not establish the analytic tail or classify exceptional algebraic t. The normalized vertex coordinates need not be rational; the pairwise dot products and Gram entries at t=2 are rational as required.

value.rationale: For single-degree reconstruction on the standard truncated-octahedral directions, dimension alone would not indicate loss of a sample after surjectivity has already occurred. The exact forbidden data combination, sharp permanent cutoff, and distinction between a symmetry-forced obstruction and a parameter-specific accident are useful interpolation information. The fixed target is a canonical geometric orbit rather than a hand-picked finite instance.
residual_risks: Ranks do not guarantee good numerical conditioning or robustness under removing vertices.
